param.name: govuk.branding
param.desc: Branding mode. 'neutral' (default) uses system fonts and no crown; 'istanduk' adds the iStandUK theme (logo, brand colours) on top of neutral; 'nhs' applies the NHS Design System palette and typography (for NHS organisations only); 'official' applies full GOV.UK branding — the crown logo and GDS Transport font — for genuine GOV.UK services only (see the manual). NHS and official identity assets are restricted; the build warns.

param.name: govuk.service.name
param.desc: Service or publication name shown in the masthead and footer. Defaults to the map title.

param.name: govuk.phase
param.desc: Show a GOV.UK phase banner above the content with this tag, e.g. 'alpha' or 'beta'. Empty (default) shows no banner. Works in every branding mode. The print document's cover shows it as the publication's status.

param.name: govuk.feedback.url
param.desc: Feedback link shown in the phase banner (used only when govuk.phase is set). Empty (default) shows the banner text without a link.

param.name: govuk.service.url
param.desc: Target of the masthead home link (service or publication home). Empty (default) links to the generated site's own home page.

param.name: govuk.favicon
param.desc: Path to a favicon file (.ico, .png or .svg) to copy into the output and link from every page. Empty (default) ships no favicon.

param.name: govuk.footer.links
param.desc: Extra footer links, as a semicolon-separated list of 'label|url' pairs (for example 'Privacy|/privacy;Contact|/contact'). Empty (default) shows only the generated support links.

param.name: govuk.footer.licence
param.desc: Override the footer licence/credit line (neutral, iStandUK and NHS modes; official mode always shows the Open Government Licence). Empty (default) uses the bookmap's bookmeta copyright, or the map title.

param.name: govuk.homepage.layout
param.desc: Landing-page layout. 'auto' (default) selects from the map's shape: one top-level entry gives a start-button page, a few give an annotated contents list, many or multi-chapter bookmaps give grouped sections.

param.name: govuk.homepage.depth
param.desc: How many levels of the map the landing page shows (grid, grouped, accordion, and start layouts). 1 = top-level entries only; 2 (default) = entries plus their children; higher values nest deeper.

param.name: govuk.search
param.desc: Site search via Pagefind. 'auto' (default) enables search when the Pagefind binary is found; 'yes' requires it (build fails without it); 'no' disables search.

param.name: govuk.pagefind.cmd
param.desc: Path to the Pagefind executable. Defaults to 'pagefind' on the PATH.

param.name: govuk.search.ranking
param.desc: How search results are scored. 'default' (Pagefind's own scoring); 'reference' (raw term counts, no long-page penalty: exact-title pages first, suited to dictionaries, catalogues and standards); or a JSON object of Pagefind ranking options passed through as-is, e.g. {"termFrequency":0,"pageLength":0,"metaWeights":{"keywords":3}}.

param.name: govuk.pagination
param.desc: Show previous/next links (GOV.UK pagination) at the foot of each page in the map's reading order. 'yes' (default) or 'no'.

param.name: govuk.svg.inline
param.desc: Inline local SVG diagrams (svgref) as native SVG so links and interactivity inside them work. 'yes' (default) inlines; 'no' keeps the image rendering.

param.name: govuk.svg.sanitize
param.desc: Remove active content from inlined SVG diagrams — script, foreignObject, event-handler attributes, script-scheme links and references to other origins. 'yes' (default) removes them; 'no' inlines the file as authored. Findings are reported either way (GOVK004W).

param.name: govuk.inline.scope
param.desc: Where inlined SVG and MathML may come from. 'input' (default): only files under the input directory; 'any': wherever the reference points on the build machine. A reference outside the input directory is reported (GOVK005W).

param.name: govuk.content.warnings
param.desc: Report content the toolkit passes through that a static site should not carry — script-scheme links, images and objects fetched from another origin, object embeds — as build warnings (GOVK006W). 'yes' (default) or 'no'. Never fails the build.

param.name: govuk.content.policy
param.desc: What to do with content the warnings report. 'warn' (default) renders it as authored; 'strip' replaces it with a marked placeholder carrying the alt text or description.

param.name: govuk.csp
param.desc: Content-Security-Policy on every page. 'no' (default) emits none; 'meta' emits a policy the plugin's pages satisfy (same-origin only, the one constant inline script by hash, WebAssembly for search) as a meta tag, for hosts without header control; any other value is emitted as given. Content the policy would block is reported (GOVK007W).

param.name: govuk.site.url
param.desc: The published base URL of the site (for example https://example.org/manual/). Needed for sitemap.xml, whose entries must be absolute, and given on the print document's cover as where the current version is; the plugin has no other way to know its own address.

param.name: govuk.sitemap
param.desc: Write sitemap.xml (and a robots.txt pointing at it, unless one exists) from the map's navigable pages. 'auto' (default) writes it when govuk.site.url is set; 'yes' requires the URL; 'no' never writes it. The search page and the print document are excluded.

param.name: govuk.dates
param.desc: Show a topic's critdates as a metadata line beneath its summary. 'no' (default); 'updated' shows the last revised date (or the created date when there is none); 'both' shows published and last updated. The date shown is only as good as the source.

param.name: govuk.metadata
param.desc: Metadata in each page's head, read from the DITA (design 14). 'basic' (default) writes the canonical, previous, next and licence links, Open Graph tags and Dublin Core tags; 'no' writes none. URL-valued tags need govuk.site.url. The print document carries none.

param.name: govuk.organisation
param.desc: The publishing organisation's name, for metadata. Default: the bookmap's publisherinformation organization, else its bookowner organization.

param.name: govuk.organisation.url
param.desc: The publishing organisation's home page, an absolute http(s) URL, for metadata.

param.name: govuk.og.image
param.desc: The image shown when a page is shared (og:image): an absolute http(s) URL, or a path under the site root, which needs govuk.site.url.

param.name: govuk.licence.url
param.desc: The URL of the licence the content is published under, for metadata (rel=license). Official branding states the Open Government Licence without it.

param.name: govuk.metadata.persons
param.desc: Name the authors in metadata. 'no' (default) gives the organisation as the creator; 'yes' gives the author elements' names.

param.name: govuk.print
param.desc: Also write the whole publication as one self-contained file, print.html, for printing or saving as PDF from a browser, and for rendering as PDF (govuk.pdf): cover, contents, every topic in reading order, glossary and index. 'no' (default) or 'yes'. Linked from the cover and the footer.

param.name: govuk.print.max-topics
param.desc: Largest publication (distinct topic files) for which the print document is written; above it the build warns (GOVK003W) and writes none, so no PDF is made either. Default 500.

param.name: govuk.print.books
param.desc: Whether a bookmap's parts are also printed as books of their own. 'whole' (default): one print document and PDF for the bookmap. 'parts': those, and one print document and PDF per part, its cover taking the part's title and the bookmap's publisher information, without the glossary and index. A map that references bookmaps always gets one per bookmap as well, whatever this says.

param.name: govuk.print.scope
param.desc: What the print document (and so the PDF) holds. 'navigation' (default): the topics in the map's navigation; links to anything else go to the website. 'linked': those, and every local topic their links reach, each placed beneath the topic that first links to it, so a reference work whose items are reached only from index pages prints whole. Above govuk.print.max-topics the print document keeps to the navigation and the build says so (GOVK010W).

param.name: govuk.print.toc.depth
param.desc: How many map levels the print document's contents list shows. 1-9; default 3.

param.name: govuk.pdf.paper
param.desc: Paper size for printing: a CSS page-size keyword (A5, A4, A3, B5, B4, JIS-B5, JIS-B4, Letter, Legal, Ledger) or a width and height as CSS lengths such as '210mm 297mm'. Default A4. Written into the print stylesheet, so it applies to printing from a browser and to the PDF a formatter renders.

param.name: govuk.pdf
param.desc: Render the print document as a page-numbered PDF with DesignSystemPDF, the project's own generator, which is installed separately. 'auto' (default) makes the PDF when the generator is found on the PATH or at govuk.pdf.cmd and govuk.print=yes, and otherwise says so in the log; 'yes' stops the build if the generator is missing or govuk.print is not 'yes'; 'no' makes no PDF. When the PDF is produced, the cover and every footer link it, with its size, beside the print version. A failure is reported as a warning and the site is still complete.

param.name: govuk.pdf.cmd
param.desc: The DesignSystemPDF launcher: a name looked for on the PATH, or a path to it. Default 'designsystempdf'.

param.name: govuk.pdf.fonts
param.desc: A folder of TrueType fonts for DesignSystemPDF: used where the publisher's stylesheets name them, and for characters the bundled fonts lack. Empty (default) uses the bundled fonts.

param.name: govuk.pdf.command
param.desc: Another formatter to render the print document as PDF, used in place of DesignSystemPDF, run after the site is built when govuk.print=yes. The print document's path and the output PDF's path are appended as the last two arguments, so 'weasyprint' becomes 'weasyprint <print.html> <publication.pdf>'. Empty (default) leaves the choice to govuk.pdf. A CSS Paged Media formatter resolves the page references the print stylesheet generates — page numbers in the contents, the index and cross-references — which browsers cannot. The plugin bundles no formatter and downloads nothing; a failure is reported as a warning and the site is still complete.

param.name: govuk.pdf.name
param.desc: File name for the generated PDF, without the extension. Defaults to the input map's name.

param.name: govuk.pdf.orientation
param.desc: Page orientation for printing with a named paper size: 'portrait' (default) or 'landscape'.
